div.head: AGu 5
div.ab: ⁊ ealle we cwædon on ðam dæge ðe mon ða aðas swor, þæt ne ðeowe ne freo ne moton in ðone here faran butan leafe, ne heora nan ða ma to us. Gif ðonne gebyrige, þæt for neode heora hwylc wið ure bige habban wille oððe we wið heora mid yrfe ⁊ mid æhtum, ðæt is to ðafianne on ða wisan, þæt man gislas sylle friðe to wedde ⁊ to swutulunge, þæt man wite, ðæt man clæne bæc hæbbe.

And we declared, on the day that oaths were sworn, that neither slaves nor freemen should be allowed to pass over to the Danish host with out permission, any more than that any of them [should come over] to us. If, however, it happens that any of them, in order to satisfy their wants, wish to trade with us, or we [for the same reason wish to trade] with them, in cattle and in goods, it shall be allowed on condition that hostages are given as security for peaceful behaviour, and as evidence by which it may be known that no treachery is intended.

⁊ ealle hig gecwædon ða man þa aðas swor, þæt naðor ne we on þone hére faran buton leafe, ne heora nan ða ma to us, buton man trywan ⁊ betwynan gyslas sylle, friðe to wedde ⁊ to swutulunge, þæt man mid rihte fare, gyf þæt geneodige, þæt ure ænig to oðrum fáce mid yrfe and min æhtum.
